verdict.rationale: iTerm2 is a scriptable terminal emulator, not primarily an agent, so shipping an official MCP server that lets agents drive its sessions is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions an MCP server. The Python API, AppleScript support and built-in LLM chat are developer building blocks or adjacent features, so they earn no credit, and the llms.txt and OpenAPI probes return 404.
